Description:
Compare two Result instances for inequality.
A Result that contains a value is unequal to every Result containing an error. A Result
containing a value is equal to another Result only if both contain the same type, and either that
type is void or the value of that type compares equal. A Result containing an error is equal to
another Result only if both contain the same error type, and the contained errors compare equal.
